title: mail JMAP MethodError helpers missing variants for RFC 8620 error types
description: mail/jmap/types.rs ErrorType enum covers UnknownCapability, NotJSON, NotRequest but helper constructors (lines 67-81) only provide unknown_method, invalid_arguments, not_found, forbidden. Missing: Limit, OverQuota, InvalidResultReference, RequestTooLarge, StateMismatch. Future feature code will construct JSON manually. Add builders for all RFC 8620 §9.6.1 error types.
